info.title: MADP Panel API Contract
info.description: The routes any panel serves to work with MADP. Based on the T2O backend API: routes under /api/v1, the {status, message, data} envelope, a bearer token for read and sync routes and signed x-madp-* headers for /api/v1/admin. A panel declares its capabilities at GET /api/v1/contract and MADP calls only those. See docs/PANEL_API_CONTRACT.md.

tags.name: contract.discovery
tags.description: Contract discovery. Tells MADP which contract version the panel speaks and which capabilities it offers.

tags.name: questions.read
tags.description: Question list. The profile questions, so MADP can map them to its attribute registry.

tags.name: options.read
tags.description: Answer options. The options of each question, for value mapping.

tags.name: questionnaires.read
tags.description: Profile questionnaires. Which questions belong to which profile, page by page.

tags.name: members.read
tags.description: Member list (full import). A full member import. Optional when the changes feeds are served.

tags.name: answers.read
tags.description: One member’s answers. A full answer import for named members.

tags.name: changes.members
tags.description: Member changes feed. Automatic sync: members changed since the last run.

tags.name: changes.answers
tags.description: Answer changes feed. Automatic sync: answers changed since the last run.

tags.name: changes.deletions
tags.description: Deletions feed. Deleted members and reset answers, so MADP deletes them too.

tags.name: changes.rewards
tags.description: Reward changes feed. Points rows for MADP’s read-only loyalty mirror.

tags.name: changes.responses
tags.description: Survey response changes feed. Survey outcomes for the loyalty mirror and survey reports.

tags.name: special_category
tags.description: Special-category answers. Declares that some answers are special-category (health) data. MADP then applies purpose checks, guardian consent for minors and larger cell sizes.

tags.name: webhooks.push
tags.description: Change webhooks. The panel tells MADP that something changed, so sync runs at once instead of on the schedule.

tags.name: admin.members
tags.description: Member admin. Search, view and edit members, status, segment, ledger and unmasking with a reason.

tags.name: admin.members.actions
tags.description: Member actions. Password reset and welcome e-mails, and “log in as member” with session tracking.

tags.name: admin.members.engagement
tags.description: Member engagement view. What the member sees, survey history, alert channels and payout method.

tags.name: admin.members.duplicates
tags.description: Duplicate accounts. Find, merge (dry run first) and undo merges of duplicate accounts.

tags.name: admin.members.archive
tags.description: Six-month check and archive. Archive inactive members and restore them.

tags.name: admin.question_bank
tags.description: Question bank. Questions, options, translations, rules, Excel import and export, and versions with review.

tags.name: admin.profiles
tags.description: Profiles. Profile questionnaires and completion rates.

tags.name: admin.segments
tags.description: Segments. Panel segments such as consumer, B2B, teens, HCP.

tags.name: admin.audiences
tags.description: Audiences. Saved audiences and their counts.

tags.name: admin.surveys
tags.description: Surveys. Surveys, feasibility, invitations, responses and reconciliation.

tags.name: admin.points
tags.description: Points. Point adjustments with four-eyes approval, and holds.

tags.name: admin.quality
tags.description: Quality and referral checks. Quality tiers, review queue, per-member quality and referral fraud.

tags.name: admin.experts
tags.description: Expert verification. Review B2B and HCP verification requests.

tags.name: admin.tickets
tags.description: Support tickets. Ticket desk with replies and notes.

tags.name: admin.messages
tags.description: Portal messages. Messages shown in the member portal.

tags.name: admin.help
tags.description: Help centre. Help articles per brand.

tags.name: admin.content
tags.description: Content and legal pages. Pages with drafts, second-person review, revisions and restore.

tags.name: admin.switches
tags.description: Feature switches. Feature on/off per brand, segment and country.

tags.name: admin.reminders
tags.description: Auto reminders and channels. Rule-based reminders and the WhatsApp and SMS provider settings.

tags.name: admin.prize_machines
tags.description: Prize machines. One prize machine per segment.

tags.name: admin.reports
tags.description: Reports. Aggregate counts per brand. No personal data.

tags.name: admin.rewards
tags.description: Rewards and redemptions. Reward catalogue and the redemption queue.

tags.name: admin.draws
tags.description: Lucky draws. Draws, run and cancel.

tags.name: admin.offers
tags.description: Offers. Bonus offers and ending them.

tags.name: admin.engagement
tags.description: Engagement studio. Tasks, ideas, stories and streaks.

tags.name: admin.teens
tags.description: Teens and guardians. Teen registrations, guardian links, turning 18.

tags.name: admin.data_requests
tags.description: Data requests. Member access and deletion requests.

bearer.description: Integration token of the panel (read and sync routes).

madpSigned.name: x-madp-signature
madpSigned.description:
hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<x-madp-timestamp>
<x-madp-nonce>
<METHOD>
<path+query>
<x-madp-origin>
<x-madp-actor>
<sha256 hex of body>"). Timestamp within 300 s; each nonce (32 hex) accepted once.
